```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("utils_freq.R")
source(if (params$paper == "flow") "config_flow.R" else "config_load.R")

# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

PARADIGM   <- params$paradigm  # "active" | "passive"
PAPER      <- params$paper      # "flow" | "load"
ELECTRODES <- c("Fpz", "Fz", "FCz", "Cz", "CPz", "Pz", "POz", "Oz")
BANDS      <- c("alpha", "low_beta", "high_beta", "theta")

STUDY      <- if (PARADIGM == "active") "Active" else "Passive"
DATE_STR   <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

PARADIGM_CFG <- list(
  active  = list(date_source = "20261016", n_label = glue("{length(INCLUDED_ACTIVE)}p")),
  passive = list(date_source = "20261016", n_label = glue("{length(INCLUDED_PASSIVE)}p"))
)
cfg <- PARADIGM_CFG[[PARADIGM]]

DATA_ROOT      <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/{PAPER}/freq/continuous/")
OUTPUT_RESULTS <- glue("L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_{STUDY}/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/{PAPER}/freq_continuous/")

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Condition pooling for load paper
# flow: UT_highflow / UT_lowflow as-is
# load: pool oddball -> Simple, UT -> Complex
prepare_data <- function(data) {
  if (PAPER == "load") {
    data %>%
      mutate(cond = case_when(
        cond %in% c("oddball_1", "oddball_2")    ~ "Simple",
        cond %in% c("UT_highflow", "UT_lowflow") ~ "Complex",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      filter(!is.na(cond)) %>%
      group_by(participant, electrode, cond) %>%
      summarise(power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    data
  }
}

COND1 <- if (PAPER == "flow") "UT_highflow" else "Simple"
COND2 <- if (PAPER == "flow") "UT_lowflow"  else "Complex"
```

```{r overview}
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: FLOW — Frequency Band Power (Continuous Epochs)  
**Paradigm**: {toupper(PARADIGM)}  
**Electrodes**: {paste(ELECTRODES, collapse = ', ')}  
**Bands**: {paste(BANDS, collapse = ', ')}  
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}  
"))
```

## Analysis

```{r analysis, results='asis'}
summary_rows      <- list()
apa_texts_anova    <- list()
apa_texts_posthoc  <- list()

for (band in BANDS) {
  cat(glue("\n## {toupper(band)} band\n\n"))

  file_name <- glue("{cfg$date_source}_{cfg$n_label}_continuous_{band}_stats.csv")
  data <- read.csv(file.path(DATA_ROOT, file_name), sep = ",")
  data    <- prepare_data(data)
  df_band <- filter_data_band(data, ELECTRODES, COND1, COND2)

  n_valid <- n_distinct(df_band$participant)
  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} participants\n\n"))

  # ── Boxplot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- create_band_boxplot(df_band, band)
  print(p)
  cat("\n")

  # ── Residual diagnostics ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit     <- fit_residuals(df_band)
  resids  <- extract_within_residuals(fit)
  shapiro <- shapiro.test(resids)
  cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk** (within-stratum residuals): W = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$statistic), 3)}, p = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$p.value), 3)}\n\n"))

  # ── Frequentist ANOVA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  res <- run_band_anova(df_band)
  tbl <- get_anova_table(res)
  cat("**Repeated-measures ANOVA:**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(tbl, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")

  # ── Sphericity: Mauchly's test + Greenhouse-Geisser correction ──────────
  # 8 electrode levels here (vs. 3 in the Castellar analysis) makes a real
  # sphericity violation considerably more likely -- worth checking, not
  # just assuming get_anova_table()'s automatic correction is enough without
  # stating it explicitly. cond alone (2 levels) has no Mauchly entry --
  # trivially satisfies sphericity, nothing to correct.
  if (!is.null(res$`Mauchly's Test for Sphericity`)) {
    cat("**Mauchly's Test for Sphericity:**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(res$`Mauchly's Test for Sphericity`, digits = 3))
    cat("\n")
    cat("**Sphericity Corrections:**\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(res$`Sphericity Corrections`, digits = 3))
    cat("\n")
  }

  # ── Bayesian ANOVA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bf_anova <- run_band_anova_bayesian(df_band)

  cat("**Bayesian repeated-measures ANOVA** (model comparison table):\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(bf_anova$bf_df, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tbl))) {
    row  <- tbl[i, ]
    term <- row$Effect
    p_val <- as.numeric(row$p)
    p_str <- format_p(p_val)
    bf_str <- if (term %in% names(bf_anova$lookup)) format_bf(bf_anova$lookup[[term]]) else "NA"
    sphericity_note <- format_sphericity_note(res, term)
    apa <- glue("{term}: F({row$DFn}, {row$DFd}) = {round(row$F, 2)}, {p_str}, ",
               "\u03b7\u00b2_p = {round(as.numeric(row$pes), 3)}, \u03b7\u00b2_g = {round(as.numeric(row$ges), 3)}, ",
               "BF10 = {bf_str} {sphericity_note}")
    cat(glue("- {apa}\n"))
    apa_texts_anova[[glue("{band}_{term}")]] <- apa
  }
  cat("\n")

  # ── Posthoc: frequentist ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("**Post-hoc** (paired t-tests, Bonferroni):\n\n")
  posthoc <- df_band %>%
    group_by(electrode) %>%
    pairwise_t_test(power ~ cond, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj")

  # ── Posthoc: Bayesian ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bf_posthoc <- run_band_posthoc_bayesian(df_band, COND1, COND2)
  posthoc <- posthoc %>% left_join(bf_posthoc, by = "electrode")

  print(knitr::kable(posthoc, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(posthoc))) {
    row  <- posthoc[i, ]
    elec <- as.character(row$electrode)

    stats <- df_band %>%
      filter(electrode == elec) %>%
      group_by(cond) %>%
      summarise(M = round(mean(power, na.rm = TRUE), 2), SD = round(sd(power, na.rm = TRUE), 2), .groups = "drop")

    m1  <- stats$M[stats$cond  == COND1]; sd1 <- stats$SD[stats$cond == COND1]
    m2  <- stats$M[stats$cond  == COND2];  sd2 <- stats$SD[stats$cond == COND2]
    dval <- round(calc_cohens_d_posthoc(df_band, COND1, COND2, elec, "power"), 2)
    p_str <- format_p(as.numeric(row$p.adj))

    apa <- glue(
      "{elec}: High Flow (M={m1}, SD={sd1}) vs Low Flow (M={m2}, SD={sd2}), ",
      "t({row$df}) = {round(row$statistic, 2)}, {p_str}, d = {dval}, BF10 = {format_bf(row$BF10)}"
    )
    cat(glue("- {apa}\n"))
    apa_texts_posthoc[[glue("{band}_{elec}")]] <- apa

    summary_rows[[glue("{band}_{elec}")]] <- tibble(
      Band = band, Electrode = elec,
      Mean_High = m1, SD_High = sd1, Mean_Low = m2, SD_Low = sd2,
      t = round(row$statistic, 3), df = row$df, p = round(as.numeric(row$p.adj), 4),
      d = dval, BF10 = round(row$BF10, 3), BF01 = round(row$BF01, 3)
    )
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Summary Table

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
knitr::kable(summary_df, digits = 3, caption = glue("{toupper(PAPER)} | {toupper(PARADIGM)} | Frequency Power (Continuous)"))
```

```{r save-summary}
out_fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_RESULTS, glue("{PARADIGM}_{PAPER}_freq_continuous_summary_{DATE_STR}.csv"))
write.csv(summary_df, out_fname, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved summary ->", out_fname, "\n")
```
